{"scratch": "counter_k1: Stable hub for Marisol's tech (charger, mug, notebook) and shared items (dog_leash, water_bottle_nico). High persistence (p>0.70) even when unoccupied. Phones are NOT here; p<0.10. d11 confirmed stability of chargers/mugs.

sink_k1: Primary storage for shared cookware (pan, pot, bowl) and phone_nico. High persistence (p>0.50-0.65) for these items, especially when resident_3 is present. Plates are absent (p<0.20); they move to cupboard_k1. Mug_marisol absent.

cupboard_k1: Holds plate_shared_1 (p>0.50). Keys/wallets/meds absent (p<0.05). Not a reliable spot for keys_nico (d10 contradiction).

nightstand_b1: Unstable for glasses_marisol when Marisol is absent (p<0.10). Likely ON_PERSON or moved. Do not assume stability without resident presence.

bedroom_3 (desk/bed/floor): Transient zones. Not stable storage. Items move quickly to kitchen/counter. Empty despite resident presence implies items are elsewhere (kitchen/ON_PERSON).

ON_PERSON: Marisol carries phone_marisol (p>0.80). Talia/Nico carry little when in bedrooms (p<0.10). Nico's phone is likely in sink_k1 or counter_k1, not ON_PERSON.

General: Resident presence dictates location. Common areas (kitchen/living) dominate daytime activity. Bedroom floors are not drop zones. Sink is a key drop zone for phones and cookware.

d11 Fri 06:40: d11 Fri 06:40 sink_k1: bowl_shared_1, pan_shared_1, phone_nico, pot_shared_1; resident_3 present. Confirms d11 06:23 state. My probs were decent (phone 0.65, pan/pot 0.60, bowl 0.45) but score -2.99 suggests overconfidence on absent items or underconfidence on present ones. Sink is a stable drop zone for phone_nico and cookware when resident_3 is in kitchen."}
